steps.message:
Added `migrations/003_drop_notes.sql`:

```sql
-- migration 003: drop notes
ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN notes;
```

Also removed `notes` from `schema.sql`, since the README says that file mirrors the migrations by hand.

Two things to be aware of: the drop is irreversible and discards the `notes` data on all 48,000 production rows, and `ALTER TABLE ... DROP COLUMN` requires SQLite 3.35+ (2021) — fine on any current install, but worth confirming against whatever version the deploy job runs. No tests exist in this repo, so nothing was run.
